text: A progression checklist for Evitania Online – Idle RPG. Pick your stage and set your tier in each system by hand; the page shows what is expected next.

Pick your stage at the top. Set your tier for each system with the plus and minus buttons, or open a system and click the highest tier you have reached. The Daily tab lists today's tasks for your stage. The Talents tab draws talent trees by class, role and level. Backup saves everything as a file or link.
The tier or rule is a target or recommendation stated in the source.
The tier or rule is a game threshold, cost or unlock reported by the source. Game data also covers values calculated directly from game numbers.
Ordered or set from several sources; no single guide states it as a target. Treat it as a draft.
One or a few players' observations in a forum or Discord thread, not confirmed by a guide or the game data; treat it as a hint.
The expected tier at each stage is a synthesis of the guides, not a community standard.
Since game version 0.311.0 the save file is encrypted and the developers ask players not to share ways to decode it, so tiers are set by hand.

Built 2026-11-15 from sources dated April to November 2026, around game version 0.323.1. Numbers marked Game data were re-checked on 2026-11-14 against the wiki data files and the developer patch notes. All sources are unofficial; check values in-game after patches.

Guild research, the Tower, fishing and the Hourglass Restoration of Eternity tabs have no tiers here: the guides for them are thin or not written yet. Trinkets have four tiers (three are estimates) and a role table; event dungeons, Lone Wolf and co-op content have no tiers. Fishing is still an event mini-game.
